newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela electricity demand up 3.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela electricity demand up 3.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Electricity demand in Venezuela rose 3.5 percent in 1996, the Venezuelan Electricity Industry Chamber (CAVEINEL) said Friday.
Demand rose to 56,535 gigawatts (GW) from 54,594 GW in 1995, CAVEINEL said in a statement.
Broken down by sectors, residential demand rose 5.5 percent and industrial demand 5.8 percent, while commercial and public sector demand fell.
Hydroelectric power plants supplied 75 percent of Venezuela's energy needs in 1996, the statement added.
